chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Zurara who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Mufrid (one who performs Hajj al-Mufrad) who enters Mecca: does he advance his Tawaf or delay it? He said, 'It is the same.'

key_terms.اَلْمُفْرِدُ لِلْحَجِّ: Mufrid: A pilgrim who performs Hajj al-Mufrad, entering Mecca with the intention of Hajj only, without Umrah.
key_terms.طَوَافَهُ: Tawaf: The ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba.
key_terms.يُؤَخِّرُهُ: Yu'akhkhiruhu: To delay or perform later.
key_terms.يُقَدِّمُ: Yuqaddim: To advance or perform early.

ai.seo_question: When should a Mufrid pilgrim perform their first Tawaf upon arriving in Mecca?
ai.summary: Recorded by the prominent companion Zurarah, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) establishes flexibility in the timing of the Tawaf al-Qudum for Mufrid pilgrims, reflecting the Shia principle of ease in ritual worship. It highlights the scholarly consensus on the permissibility of delaying the initial circumambulation until one is ready, thereby removing unnecessary hardship from the pilgrim's experience.
